step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard depicts a Kubernetes monitoring architecture built on Amazon EKS. Centralized monitoring and logging tools (AppOptics, Loggly, PaperTrail) are grouped in a blue box at the top, connected via an explicit green visual line to Amazon CloudWatch. Amazon EKS orchestrates three node daemon sets/containers at the bottom: an AppOptics agent container (collecting application traces from MySQL and PHP/Nginx), a Prometheus container (collecting metrics), and a Fluentd container (collecting logs).
